notes: «فإني لقاعد عند أبي سعيد» gives the place; Abu Sa'id is a link because he is asked and answers and his words are the saying (rule 6); Ibn Umar and Ibn Abbas are in the scene, their opinions described, not links; «فحدثني أبو الصهباء» starts a second saying (Ibn Abbas disliking it) with its own isnad: not a route of this saying, flagged under rule 11 (two sayings in one report)
